Container.Name: PiGallery2 Plus
Container.Overview: PiGallery2 Plus is a performance and metadata focused fork of PiGallery2 for large self-hosted photo and video archives. It keeps the fast directory-first gallery experience while adding improved infinite browsing, richer metadata display, share-link fixes, public random-image links, activity audit logs, wider video transcoding support, and a more ergonomic lightbox player. Mount your media library read-only for safer public exposure.

Config.Name: WebUI - HTTP host port
Config.Description: Host port for the PiGallery2 Plus web interface.

Config.Name: Paths - Config
Config.Description: Persistent PiGallery2 Plus configuration, including config.json and extension configuration.

Config.Name: Paths - Database
Config.Description: Persistent database folder. SQLite databases and job history live here.

Config.Name: Paths - Temp and cache
Config.Description: Temporary files, thumbnails, transcoding cache and generated assets. Put this on SSD/cache for best performance.

Config.Name: Paths - Media library
Config.Description: Your photo and video archive. The default mapping is read-only and recommended for public galleries.

Config.Name: Core - TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used by the container, for example Europe/Paris.

Config.Name: Core - NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Runtime mode. Use production for normal deployments; debug is only for troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional public base URL, for example https://gallery.example.com. Set this when generating share links or random-image URLs behind a reverse proxy.
